name: Panels & distribution boards
Paneli na bodi za usambazaji
intro: Organize incoming power and outgoing circuits around your building’s loads.
Panga umeme unaoingia na saketi kulingana na mizigo ya jengo lako.
selection: Supply, load schedule and outgoing circuits.
Umeme uliopo, orodha ya mizigo na saketi.
Fault level, protection, enclosure and expansion space.
Kiwango cha hitilafu, ulinzi, enclosure na nafasi ya upanuzi.
Power-factor correction, where required, follows load and harmonic assessment.
Power-factor correction inapohitajika hufuata tathmini ya mizigo na harmonics.

name: Switchgear & circuit breakers
Switchgear na circuit breaker
intro: Select switching and protection devices that suit the system—not just the current rating.
Chagua vifaa vya switching na ulinzi vinavyofaa mfumo—si kiwango cha ampere pekee.
selection: Operating voltage, poles and load current.
Voltage ya matumizi, poles na mkondo wa mzigo.
Breaking capacity and coordination with other protection.
Uwezo wa kukata hitilafu na uratibu wa vifaa vingine vya ulinzi.
Existing equipment references and compatible accessories.
Taarifa za vifaa vilivyopo na accessories zinazooana.

name: Motor control & drives
Udhibiti wa mota na VFD
intro: Match pumps and machinery to the right starting, speed-control and protection approach.
Linganisha pampu na mashine na njia sahihi ya kuanzisha, kudhibiti kasi na kulinda mota.
selection: Motor nameplate, supply and driven equipment.
Nameplate ya mota, umeme na mashine inayotumika.
Duty, starting method and operating environment.
Namna ya kazi, kuanzisha na mazingira ya matumizi.
Required controls, interlocks and specialist/OEM interfaces.
Udhibiti, interlocks na miingiliano ya mtaalamu au mtengenezaji.

name: Transformers & substation equipment
Transfoma na vifaa vya kituo
intro: Define the connection and demand before specifying a transformer or substation package.
Fafanua uunganishaji na mahitaji ya mzigo kabla ya kuainisha transfoma au vifaa vya kituo.
selection: Utility supply requirements and incoming/outgoing voltage.
Masharti ya mtoa huduma na voltage zinazoingia na kutoka.
Load demand, site conditions and protection design.
Mahitaji ya mzigo, hali ya eneo na usanifu wa ulinzi.
Agree supply, qualified installation and commissioning responsibilities separately.
Kubalianeni tofauti majukumu ya ugavi, ufungaji wenye idhini na commissioning.

name: Cables & termination accessories
Nyaya na vifaa vya termination
intro: Plan power and control cabling as a complete route, including glands and terminations.
Panga nyaya za nguvu na udhibiti kwa njia nzima, pamoja na gland na termination.
selection: Circuit load, voltage, route length and installation method.
Mzigo wa saketi, voltage, urefu na namna ya kufunga.
Environment, protection and conductor requirements.
Mazingira, ulinzi na mahitaji ya conductor.
Cable schedule or samples/references for existing terminations.
Orodha ya nyaya au sampuli/taarifa za termination zilizopo.

name: Earthing & surge protection
Earthing na kinga ya surge
intro: Coordinate earthing, bonding and surge protection with the installation’s design.
Ratibu earthing, bonding na kinga ya surge kulingana na usanifu wa mfumo.
selection: Existing earthing arrangement and site measurements.
Mpangilio wa earthing uliopo na vipimo vya eneo.
Supply characteristics and surge/lightning assessment.
Sifa za umeme na tathmini ya surge/radi.
Correctly coordinated devices, connections and inspection access.
Vifaa na miunganisho iliyoratibiwa, pamoja na ufikiaji wa ukaguzi.
